final_synthesis_description: Immediately pause to deliver a 1-2 sentence acknowledgment and conduct a rapid safety and needs check (30-60 seconds); if there is any sign of urgency, distress, or explicit need for presence, notify teammates and exit the match entirely to provide full emotional support — the 'complete current segment' branch is effectively eliminated, as the act of seeking support is itself treated as time-sensitive.
remaining_disagreements: How concretely to define the urgency threshold that triggers full exit vs. brief delay
Whether any 'finish current segment' exception should survive at all, or be fully removed
How detailed the communication plan to teammates/opponents should be during the triage moment
